report.incidentSummary: On the morning of 2026-10-14, users reported that mutual fund portfolio values and P&L were showing stale previous-day values (dated 2026-10-12) with no visible client errors, while stock holdings updated normally. The investigation revealed that market-data-service's scheduled nightly nav-import job at 23:30 IST (18:00 UTC) on 2026-10-13 aborted when parsing AMFI's NAVAll.txt file due to an unhandled 'N.A.' value for scheme code 118191. This resulted in 0 of 14,231 NAVs being committed, leaving stale NAVs active in market-data-service across the morning portfolio opening.
report.rootCauseStatement: The nightly NAV import batch job failed on market-data-service at 2026-10-13T18:02:00Z after encountering an unhandled non-numeric string ('N.A.') at line 8982 for scheme code 118191 in the AMFI NAVAll.txt feed file. The batch aborted with an all-or-nothing failure (0 of 14,231 records saved), causing market-data-service to continue serving stale mutual fund NAVs from 2026-10-12 while nav_age_s climbed past 34 hours without any automated retry or alerting.

hypotheses.cause: market-data-service aborted the nightly nav-import batch at line 8982 of AMFI's NAVAll.txt due to an unhandled 'N.A.' value for scheme code 118191, resulting in 0 of 14,231 NAVs written and leaving stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12 active.
hypotheses.rationale: Exact logs from market-data-service and job-scheduler show that nav-import was scheduled and executed at 18:00 UTC, downloaded NAVAll.txt at 18:01 UTC, crashed with a parse error on 'N.A.' at 18:02 UTC, and aborted with exit code 1 at 18:06 UTC with 0 records written. Metric nav_age_s climbed monotonically past 125,000s without resetting.

hypotheses.cause: External provider amfi-nav-feed published malformed data containing 'N.A.' instead of a valid numeric NAV for scheme code 118191 in NAVAll.txt, violating the expected feed schema.
hypotheses.rationale: The AMFI feed file contained the non-numeric string 'N.A.' on line 8982, though whether AMFI contracts explicitly permit 'N.A.' for non-traded/suspended schemes has not been verified.

hypotheses.cause: Deployment CHG-48221 of portfolio-service v7.3.0 at 03:40 UTC (09:10 IST) containing a 'valuation code refactor' introduced a regression in portfolio calculations.
hypotheses.rationale: portfolio-service v7.2.0 was already logging stale NAV warnings ('nav_date=2026-10-12') as early as 02:16:24 UTC and 03:36:34 UTC, well before deployment CHG-48221 took place at 03:40:00 UTC. The deployment merely coincided with peak morning user traffic opening the app.

facts.statement: job-scheduler triggered nav-import at 2026-10-13T18:00:00Z and marked it failed with exit code 1 at 2026-10-13T18:06:00Z.

market-data-service downloaded NAVAll.txt (1980 KB) from amfi-nav-feed at 18:01:00Z, encountered a parse error on line 8982 ('invalid NAV value N.A. for scheme code 118191') at 18:02:00Z, and aborted the import with 0 of 14,231 NAVs written, leaving the previous day's NAV set active.
nav_age_s on market-data-service climbed monotonically from 82,740 s at 2026-10-13T17:00Z to 125,460 s at 2026-10-14T04:55Z without resetting.
portfolio-service price_age_s remained healthy at ~2.01s and stock price tick batches processed normally throughout 02:00 to 05:00 UTC.

portfolio-service was deployed to version 7.3.0 at 03:40:00 UTC (09:10 IST), but warnings about mutual fund NAVs being older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-10-12) were already logged on version 7.2.0 starting at 02:16:24 UTC.

inferences.statement: Mutual fund valuations displayed yesterday's values because market-data-service continued serving stale NAVs from 2026-10-12 following the aborted batch.
Stock valuations remained accurate and fresh because live broker ticks flow via a separate real-time pipeline independent of the nightly AMFI batch.
The timing of user complaints at 09:10 IST coincided with users waking up and opening the app rather than the deployment CHG-48221 of portfolio-service.

assumptions.statement: market-data-service parser is designed to fail closed across all records upon an unhandled row parse error rather than continuing and recording a null or skipping the invalid scheme.
